quarterly_data.signal: Simulations Plus completed its acquisition by affiliates of Altaris, LLC (a healthcare-focused investment firm): it has become a privately held company and its common stock will no longer trade on the Nasdaq Global Select Market. In connection with closing it is being combined with Chemical Computing Group (CCG), an Altaris portfolio company providing molecular modeling and drug discovery software, to form a platform spanning drug discovery, modeling, simulation and development; Simulations Plus will continue to operate under its own name and brand.
